response.title: Aakhri Chitthi: Bansi Kaka Knows
response.hook: Six years I've delivered letters to that house. Not one ever came from you.
response.positioning: A village mystery told through the people who know everyone's letters.
response.rationale: Recorded plan: lead with Bansi Kaka and village texture, keep kinship terms in the original, no protected reveals.
